snippet.title: Wildwood Down OUT NOW! 🎡🏄‍♂️🔥
snippet.description:
The long wait is over! Go play Wildwood Down now! 

🕹Play it Here ➡ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575370/Wildwood_Down/

Thanks everyone for all the support! We just know your going to have a grand time playing Wildwood Down. (Early purchases go a looooong way for our games visibility and it helps small indie Dev's like us go against the giants of the industry.) So thank you, thank you, thank you! 🙌🙌🙌
Have Fun!🤙🎡

If your just discovering this... Our game is a Feel-Good Summer Adventure starring the best protagonist ever! - When Daniel stumbles on the murder of his good friend he's forced to navigate the wacky beach side characters, solve kooky puzzles, and crack the case before his sister is next!

Join the Discord and hang with us  ➡ https://discord.gg/NnESnykkE5
